title: Agriflow
tagline: Harvesting Global Wellbeing: Cultivating a Fresh Tomorrow.
description:
1. Lack of transparency in supply chains leads to unethical practices, environmental degradation, and compromised product quality.
2. Climate change affects the quality and condition of goods during transportation and storage, leading to significant losses and waste.
3. Traditional centralized marketplaces often marginalize local producers and artisans, hindering sustainable economic development.
4. Conventional supply chains contribute to a significant carbon footprint due to inefficient transportation and logistics.
5. Linear economies contribute to resource depletion and waste accumulation, impacting the environment negatively.
6. Lack of community involvement in sustainable initiatives limits the impact of sustainability efforts.

how_its_made: Integrating IoT devices to track the condition of goods in real time requires handling data from various sensors and ensuring seamless communication with the blockchain.
